title: Predictive ability of malnutrition screening tools in enterally fed, mechanically ventilated patients with phase angle inference: A prospective observational study.
summary: A prospective cohort assessed malnutrition-screening prediction in mechanically ventilated patients using phase angle inference. The publisher Methods and Results were checked; this conclusion is limited to the study cohort, reference standard and validation described there. The result is reported in the Journal of Critical Care Medicine. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
